title: Ostomy Supply Program Standing Reduction for Urology and Continence Supply Program Account Holders
content:
A standing reduction applies to the Ostomy Supply Program charge for a refill shipped expedited at the customer's request, according to the customer's continence account under the Urology and Continence Supply Program. The continence balance is the running total of the patient-balance postings on all of the customer's continence programs: remittance patient responsibility, patient charges and refunds, less patient payments and balance adjustments.

| Customer's continence records | Standing rate |
|---|---|
| An active continence program and a continence balance of USD 0.00 or less | 5% (the clear-account rate) |
| An active continence program and a continence balance above USD 0.00 and below USD 50.00 | 2% (the low-balance rate) |
| Any other customer | None |

The standing rate is taken off the fee.

**Cases (hypothetical, active continence program).** Balance USD 0.00 or a credit: 5%. Balance USD 49.99: 2%. Balance USD 50.00: none. Without an active continence program: none.
